programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    marks = [(c - r, value) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value]

    period = next(
        p for p in range(1, height + width + 1)
        if all(
            len({value for offset, value in marks if offset % p == residue}) <= 1
            for residue in {offset % p for offset, _ in marks}
        )
    )
    colors = {offset % period: value for offset, value in marks}
    return [[colors[(c - r) % period] for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
'''
path=programs/'task-50da358f.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path, path.read_text())
